author: 4ce_
body:
IGN: Immortalz

Staff that Banned Me: Muzzing

Reason/Rule Broken: Hacking (Hacked/Advantage Client)

Why I should be Unbanned:
I waited a couple months. I have been thinking about this ban appeal. I really have wanted to be unbanned. But its not that simple. I have understood my consequences and noticed the hurts I have caused to this server. I have deleted everything on my PC that can count as a hack and will never ever do what I did again.

Reasons why I should be unbanned:

  • The first reason is that I have noticed what I did wrong and will never ever do what I did to get banned. (HACKING). I am sincerely sorry and understand if you don't want to unban me.
  • I did not ban evade. The accounts that were also effected because of me were my siblings' accounts. They had nothing to do with it and were effected because of my causes. So was the community when I decided to toggle.
  • If I were to get a second chance, I would immediately take it. I regret my unforgivable actions and I feel like I deserve a second/final chance at this.
And I know this appeal may not look like much but I can't further explain how sincerely sorry I am for what I did. This is my last final chance at this and I am risking it to rejoin this fun and joyful community. And I know that hacking is against the rules and I got banned for it but please, let me have a second chance. A final chance to prove that I am worthy of getting back into the community.

replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your appeal, I've decided to reduce your punishment to 30 days. Keep in mind, you're very lucky you got unbanned now and it most likely won't happen again. Thus, read the rules again, and make SURE this does not happen again. (https://www.avicus.net/rules)

Best Regards,
Zeusy,
Avicus Senior Moderator
